description: This file defines a BracketMatchingService class that handles matching and validation of brackets in code, including methods for handling accepted completions and streaming output with bracket matching logic.

classes.name: BracketMatchingService
classes.description: A service class for managing bracket matching and validation during code editing and autocompletion.

methods.name: handleAcceptedCompletion
methods.description: Processes a completed code snippet to track unmatched opening brackets.

methods.name: stopOnUnmatchedClosingBracket
methods.description: Asynchronously streams code output, stopping when an unmatched closing bracket is detected.
